thought.text: The fix is applied. The `_rest_of_line` regex now tries `\r\n` before `\r` and `\n`, so CRLF is consumed as one complete newline during error recovery.

tool_call.name: finish
tool_call.arguments:
{"message": "Applied the repair in src/dotenv/parser.py only.

Change: `_rest_of_line` regex reordered from `r"[^\r\n]*(?:\r|\n|\r\n)?"` to `r"[^\r\n]*(?:\r\n|\r|\n)?"`.

Effect: On the error-recovery path in `parse_binding`, the alternation now matches `\r\n` as a single unit before falling back to lone `\r` or `\n`. For an invalid first line followed by `GOOD=ok` in CRLF input, the invalid binding's `original.string` now includes the whole CRLF, and the valid binding starts at line 2 with `original.string == "GOOD=ok\r\n"`. LF and lone-CR behavior is unchanged (single-char matches), and repeated invalid lines still recover correctly since each consumes exactly one newline.

No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were modified. Tests can be run by the host.", "summary": "Fixed CRLF recovery in parser.py _rest_of_line regex"}

summary: Fixed CRLF recovery in parser.py _rest_of_line regex
